title: Akiyama Mizuki — After Parties That Became A Regular Thing〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: After Parties That Became A Regular Thing（4★）
meta.Event: Someday, From the Depths of Despair

rows.Line: Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What?! Crap, it's already 6:00 am!
And the sun's already coming up...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What's that, Enanan? You forgot about what you were doing because you were too interested in their story?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Shut up!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<I guess that's it for today.
Why don't we head back to SEKAI?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Okay. That was fun.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Night, Miku, Luka...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Hearing about how Kanade and Mafuyu met was nice...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Also, I had no idea they both had to go through so much...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I mean, Kanade literally pushed herself by composing until she became completely exhausted...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (While Mafuyu started getting more and more lost in terms of who she really is...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And yet...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Despite all odds, they kept going...
And they found each other.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's pretty unbelievable.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They're both still carrying some of that pain, but they're also looking for ways to move forward...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's like they're trying to show each other the way down this long, dark path.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're wrong!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't want to keep seeing you like this, Mizuki, because whatever you're going through is starting to affect me too...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's normal to want to help out a friend when they're in need.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So please, tell me when you feel you're ready. I'll be waiting until then.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Showing each other the way forward, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I guess that means my <K> is...)
A few days later
Diner

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Another job well done♪
Alright, let's start ordering some food!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, this fruit parfait looks amazing!
Hmm... But that's a lot of whipped cream...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What's that, Ena? Already on the desserts page?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
So what if I am?
Anyway, I'm just gonna get a salad set today...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Could it be...?
Are you trying to go on a diet?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wh-What are you talking about?
I just wasn't sure about having to eat all that whipped cream...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wh-Why are you grinning like that...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It looks like that parfait's only available for a limited time. Are you really sure about not getting it?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Grr! Yes, I know...!
On top of that, it looks delicious and photogenic...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! Then, wanna split it with me?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I still plan on getting from real food, but I sorta want something for dessert too♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh... You couldn't have just said that from the start...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Teehee.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We know what we're getting now too...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, let's get someone to take our order...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (This really is a lot of fun...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're getting fries again, right, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Of course♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I really wasn't in a good place back then...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (So I need to cherish the time Ena's given me.)
